sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed WA Police's response to its earlier recommendations about the deployment of police dogs.
sentences.support: The Commission commenced its review of the WA Police response to the recommendations, earlier than planned.

sentences.text: The two recommendations sought clearer operational rules and analysis of why Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people were overrepresented in dog deployments.

sentences.text: The Commission recognised the proposed changes but concluded that it was too early to assess whether the recommendations had been addressed.
sentences.support: However, it is considered too early to assess whether the two recommendations have been addressed.

sentences.text: The Commission planned to review progress by WA Police again after 12 months.
sentences.support: The Commission will conduct a further review of action taken by WA Police in 12 months time.

findings.quote: The Commission acknowledges the commitment of WA Police to addressing the inherent risks associated with the use of police dogs.
However, it is considered too early to assess whether the two recommendations have been addressed.
